newsitem.title: PERU: Peru rebels condemn Greek "solidarity" bomb.
newsitem.headline: Peru rebels condemn Greek "solidarity" bomb.

text.p: A spokesman for Peru's Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas condemned on Monday a "solidarity" bomb attack by another militant leftist group at the Peruvian embassy in Athens.
"We reject this sort of display of solidarity because it does not contribute to the solution of a crisis," Isaac Velazco told Reuters in a telephone interview from Hamburg, Germany.
The "Guerrilla Fighting Group" claimed responsibility in Greece for the attack outside a central Athens apartment housing the Peruvian embassy.
They said the bomb, which injured one woman, was a demonstration of solidarity with the MRTA guerrillas who hold 83 hostages in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.
"Those who feel they are revolutionaries by this action should know that an isolated action in the context of a country's class struggle does not help, but prejudices the process," Velazco said.
"We do not justify violence for the sake of violence. This solidarity has to be expressed within the negotiation process."
